title: Mandaic language - Wikipedia
text: Afro-Asiatic.Classical Mandaic is a South Eastern Babylonian Aramaic language, belonging to the same Mesopotamian dialect continuum as Babylonian Talmudic Aramaic and Koiné Babylonian Aramaic, and is not to be conflated with Syriac or other North Eastern Aramaic varieties.
